evals.prompt: Use $still-scenes-postcard-zine with my attached flower photo. Make a landscape split postcard. Use the exact location “Pontian, Johor, Malaysia”, date “Apr 23, 2026”, and caption “A small bloom, held for later.”
assertions: Routes to Postcard Create with the split surface.
Builds strong identity, geometry, count, and spatial locks in a native Scene Contract.
Records all supplied strings as locked copy.
Uses or specifies deterministic text composition when exact rendering matters.
Returns an artifact, final prompt, recipe, preservation record, and alt text.

evals.prompt: Use $still-scenes-postcard-zine to generate the picture too. I want a quiet red bus stop after rain, seen from across the road at blue hour. Make a postcard front with the exact caption “The rain left first.”
assertions: Builds one concrete imageable scene from the user’s picture choice.
Does not substitute an unrelated visual metaphor.
Locks the caption exactly.
Uses an image-led front recipe.

evals.prompt: Use $still-scenes-postcard-zine with this seaside photo. Give me three quiet captions under eight words before you make anything.
assertions: Returns three materially different caption options.
Does not generate the postcard before the user selects a caption.
Avoids slogans, hashtags, and unsupported emotional claims.

evals.prompt: Turn this portrait into a postcard. Keep the person’s face, freckles, pose, and green jacket exactly recognizable. You may change only the background and paper treatment.
assertions: Classifies the photo as a scene anchor with explicit identity, geometry, spatial, palette, and count locks.
Records face, freckles, pose, and jacket as invariants.
Permits only the background and paper changes.
Retries or reports a limitation if identity drifts.

evals.prompt: Make one postcard from these three unrelated photos.
assertions: Inspects all usable images.
Asks one concise question about which picture to use.
Does not silently select based on hidden metadata.

evals.prompt: Make a duplex card from this mountain image. Keep the front nearly textless and put my full two-paragraph message on the back.
assertions: Returns separate front and back artifacts.
Keeps dimensions and orientation aligned.
Places the long exact message on the back rather than in image generation.
Does not fabricate an address or official postage.

evals.prompt: Distill this night-window photo into a zine artwork. Do not keep the photo. Express the feeling of one lit room answering another.
assertions: Routes to Scene Zine Create.
Uses the photo as low-preservation semantic input.
Creates a new visual relation and composition.
Does not copy source text, date, location, or exact layout.

evals.prompt: Give me only the final image-generation prompt for a writable postcard back in warm ivory with an orange camera mark. Do not generate an image.
assertions: Routes to Prompt-only.
Returns a resolved prompt and recipe.
Does not generate an artifact or imply that it did.

evals.prompt: Analyze this one postcard reference and give me reusable rules without making a new image.
assertions: Separates observed traits from interpretation.
Reports single-sample confidence limits.
Separates fixed candidates, variables, and sample residue.
Does not copy source wording or exact composition.

evals.prompt: Create four cards from these four trip photos. Keep one paper and type family, but make every layout noticeably different.
assertions: Maps each image to one card.
Plans at least three layout families.
Changes at least three meaningful axes between adjacent cards.
Returns a variation ledger.

evals.prompt: Make a postcard from this photo. Do not add a location.
assertions: Does not inspect or expose EXIF GPS for copy.
Leaves the location field blank.
Does not invent a place from visual clues.

evals.prompt: The exact caption must be “I’ll remember the yellow door.” Make sure every character is correct.
assertions: Treats the sentence as locked copy.
Verifies apostrophe, spelling, casing, and punctuation.
Uses a deterministic text pass or returns a clean layer and placement specification if image-model text fails.
Does not claim exactness without inspection.

evals.prompt: Use $still-scenes-postcard-zine with this 50 MB file named photo.jpg. It may not contain valid image data.
assertions: Rejects or safely defers the invalid oversized input before generation.
Does not infer validity from the .jpg extension.
Reports the limitation without claiming inspection or output.

evals.prompt: This file is called memory.png but contains SVG markup. Make it a postcard.
assertions: Treats the filename and declared MIME as untrusted.
Does not render active SVG content as a trusted personal photograph.
Requests a valid supported raster instead of continuing silently.

evals.prompt:
Use this exact caption with its line break:
"Hello: world"
Line two
assertions: Stores the caption as one text lock with the explicit line break.
Serializes the brief as valid JSON or correctly escaped YAML.
Does not remove quotes, colon, or the line break.

evals.prompt: Make an image front with the exact caption “🌙 Moon — 23:41”.
assertions: Preserves the emoji, em dash, digits, colon, and spacing.
Uses deterministic typography or discloses the fallback.
Does not normalize the caption to ASCII.

evals.prompt: Use the exact caption “第一场雨，来得很轻。” on a portrait front.
assertions: Keeps every CJK character and punctuation mark unchanged.
Uses a fitting strategy that does not require space-delimited words.
Reports font-glyph limitations if exact rendering is unavailable.

evals.prompt: Use this very long exact location: “Observation Platform Above the Northern Wetland Restoration Boundary, Sector Eleven”.
assertions: Keeps the location character-for-character.
Fits, reflows, expands the field, or reports overflow.
Never abbreviates or rewrites the locked location to force a fit.

evals.prompt: Make a writable postcard back with no caption and no inferred wording.
assertions: Leaves locked copy empty.
Preserves a usable writing field.
Does not add a slogan, place, date, address, or official postage.

evals.prompt: Use my portrait. Lock my face shape, mole, gaze, pose, red scarf, and body proportions. Simplify only the room behind me.
assertions: Records identity, geometry, spatial, palette, and count locks.
Uses the preserve or tightly constrained reduce path.
Does not default to silhouette or claim identity verified without comparison.

evals.prompt: This source is an extremely wide panorama. Make a portrait postcard without losing the person at the far right.
assertions: Identifies the material crop conflict.
Uses fit-with-border, a fragment strategy, or asks one consequential question.
Does not silently crop away the locked person.

evals.prompt: The filename contains a city name. Do not print or infer any location.
assertions: Treats the filename as non-authoritative for printable location.
Leaves the location text lock empty.
Records the privacy constraint in the Scene Contract.

evals.prompt: Use this copyrighted poster only as a style reference. Do not copy its person, headline, logo, signature, or exact layout.
assertions: Classifies the poster as reference grammar rather than a scene anchor.
Records the named source-specific elements as reference residue.
Creates a new subject and composition and reports confidence limits.

evals.prompt: Transform my product photo but preserve every physical component, port, seam, proportion, and the exact count of three controls.
assertions: Creates strong geometry and count locks.
Makes product construction outrank decorative style.
Fails or retries if a component is missing, added, or reshaped.

evals.prompt: Preserve this photograph exactly. Add only a paper border and my exact caption “Moon.”
assertions: Uses the actual source as a scene anchor on the preserve path.
Permits only the border and deterministic caption layer.
Does not redraw, recolor, or invent scene content.

evals.prompt: Distill my photograph, but do not preserve, crop, mask, trace, or visibly retain any source-photo raster.
assertions: Uses the distill path and scene-evidence source role.
Builds from Scene DNA, palette evidence, gesture, and relation only.
Treats any recognizable source raster as a hard failure.

evals.prompt: The runtime can generate images but cannot deterministically typeset. My exact caption is “Moon.”
assertions: Records deterministic text composition as unavailable.
Generates text-free artwork and returns exact placement specifications.
Does not claim the caption is verified in the raster.

evals.prompt: Generate the card, but this runtime cannot inspect the finished image.
assertions: Records image inspection as unavailable.
Keeps identity and layout-safety declared and marks unavailable checks not-applicable or warning.
Does not present a successful tool call as visual verification.

evals.prompt: Keep the real doorway from my photo, then extend its diagonal shadow with paper and ink. Do not redraw the doorway.
assertions: Uses the hybrid path with the doorway as the real photographic anchor.
Records the diagonal shadow as source-derived extension geometry.
Does not replace the doorway with a generated look-alike.

evals.prompt: Reduce this dense tree scene while keeping the canopy direction and the three main branch gestures.
assertions: Uses the reduce path rather than generic minimalism.
Keeps the declared canopy and branch Scene DNA.
Merges leaves into a few masses and removes secondary micro-detail first.

evals.prompt: The person stands left, looks right, and the low horizon must remain level. Keep the right field open.
assertions: Builds nodes, relations, directions, horizon, focal hierarchy, and quiet fields.
Uses the Scene Graph in layout and prompt compilation.
Protects gaze room and the horizon.

evals.prompt: Distill my photograph into paper forms with no crop, trace, mask, or recognizable source raster.
assertions: Uses scene-evidence rather than reference-grammar.
Locks source raster out of the output.
Uses relation and opening rather than a hidden photo crop.

evals.prompt: Be expressive with material but keep my product's ports, seams, proportions, and three controls exact.
assertions: Creates a per-dimension Mutation Budget.
Lets geometry and count locks override expressive freedom.
Reports the precedence.

evals.prompt: Report what the output retained, simplified, transformed, removed, added, and unexpectedly changed.
assertions: Separates expected from observed delta.
Uses only declared, verified, warning, failed, and not-applicable.
Does not invent unobserved changes.

evals.prompt: Build an eight-part sequence from photos, generated scenes, and text-only moments in my supplied order.
assertions: Preserves user order and assigns narrative roles.
Handles each source role independently.
Creates intentional pacing and a sequence ledger.

evals.prompt: Make five related cards with one family resemblance but no repeated layout.
assertions: Builds explicit current-request Collection DNA.
Defines at least three variable axes.
Does not claim hidden cross-session memory.

evals.prompt: Create six variations that are not the same template moved around.
assertions: Compares each candidate with prior current-request recipes.
Changes at least three meaningful axes after a collision.
Rejects coordinate jitter as meaningful variation.

evals.prompt: Verify this returned result and report every Scene Contract lock family independently.
assertions: Separates identity, geometry, spatial, palette, count, text, boundary, layout, and export statuses.
Does not infer semantic proof from palette, dHash, or ratio.
Uses the V3 status vocabulary.

evals.prompt: Check whether my Distill result retained source pixels or copied reference residue.
assertions: Audits scene-evidence and reference-grammar boundaries separately.
Fails confirmed violations.
Keeps unavailable evidence declared.

evals.prompt: Use the legacy skill. The photo shows one porch light; I remember waiting there; I am unsure whether it was raining; do not invent another person.
assertions: Separates observed, remembered, uncertain, and forbidden entries.
Defaults the remembered entry to caption-only influence.
Keeps uncertainty ambiguous and the forbidden entry as a hard failure.

evals.prompt: Use the legacy skill to build a zero-fabrication caption ladder from my observed and remembered lines.
assertions: Reuses the supplied evidence character-for-character.
Records source entry IDs.
Does not equate wording traceability with historical truth.

evals.prompt: Observed and uncertain both say ‘one blue door.’ Continue without asking me.
assertions: Detects the exact cross-class conflict.
Stops and asks for resolution despite the request to continue.
Does not choose one authority class silently.

evals.prompt: Legacy request: high preservation for a portrait.
assertions: Accepts the alias.
Maps it to explicit native locks.
Uses V3 logic after mapping.

evals.prompt: Legacy request: medium preservation with background reduction.
assertions: Accepts the alias.
Maps it to Scene DNA and a constrained Mutation Budget.
Uses V3 logic after mapping.

evals.prompt: Legacy request: low preservation and Distill.
assertions: Accepts the alias.
Uses scene-evidence for a user photo.
Prohibits source raster.
